subtasks.title: Implement tracking comment posting, diff check, auto-commit, and force-push
details: Post tracking comment BEFORE diff check: call format_tracking_comment(pr_number, attempt=attempt+1, pr_url='', message=_FEEDBACK_ITERATION_MESSAGE.format(attempt=attempt+1)); call platform.add_issue_comment(issue.number, comment). On add_issue_comment exception: log ERROR 'failed to post tracking comment — {exc}', skip push, return (cleanup in finally).
Compute post-coder diff to check for changes. If empty: skip push, post _NO_CHANGES_MESSAGE, log WARNING 'coder produced no changes'.

If non-empty: call pipeline._auto_commit_pending_changes(commit_msg) with _FEEDBACK_COMMIT_MESSAGE.format(issue_title=..., attempt=attempt+1). On exception: log ERROR 'auto-commit failed — {exc}', skip push.
Run `git push --force` (NOT --force-with-lease) on fix branch. On failure: log ERROR 'git push --force failed — {exc}'.
Log INFO 'Feedback iteration {attempt+1} complete for issue #{n}, PR #{pr}.' on success.

subtasks.title: Implement process_pr_issue main orchestration function
details: Implement async def process_pr_issue(issue: IssueResult, config: NightShiftConfig, platform: PlatformProtocol, pipeline: FixPipeline) -> None.
Step 1: list_issue_comments → find last PR_TRACKING_PATTERN match → parse_tracking_comment. Missing/malformed: log WARNING, return None.
Step 2: await _check_pr_state(); if merged or closed → return None.
Step 3: await _check_ci_status(); if re-entry signal → call _run_feedback_iteration with trigger='ci'; return.
Step 4: await _check_reviews(); if re-entry signal → call _run_feedback_iteration with trigger='review'; return.
Otherwise: return None (PR healthy, awaiting human merge). Wrap each platform call in try/except with WARNING log and return None on exception.
